items.title: Carrick ‘100%’ sure he can lead United forward; Dortmund take on the influencers: football – live
items.summary: ⚽ All the latest news going into the weekend’s action ⚽ Premier League: weekend guide | Mail Tom Álvaro Arbeloa’s been talking ahead of Fulham’s trip to Coventry on Saturday, and buoyed up by last weekend’s much needed win over Hull. “Nothing has changed for us,” insisted the manager, “we were not winning games but we believed in ourselves, we were doing so many things well, “The most important thing [about the Hull win] is we were in same situation against Manchester United and Ipswich but didn’t win but now we had to improve in our transition and did. We controlled the ball in their half better than before.” As the Messi-Ronaldo rivalry faded, though, so too did the clásico’s relevance. This isn’t to say matches between Barcelona and Real Madrid no longer matter. They always have and always will. In 2026, however, it’s difficult to measure a clásico’s standing. Is it still the sport’s biggest fixture? Sunday’s match at Camp Nou will be watched by hundreds of millions of viewers all over the world. A clásico always carries significance, but this weekend’s edition will be especially significant. A Barça win would move them nine points clear of their rivals at the top of La Liga. A Real Madrid victory could be a catalyst for the rest of their season. Continue reading...

items.title: 'Krasse knarren' Linssen en Chery wederom de verschilmakers bij NEC

items.title: Carrick opent persconferentie met speech van zes minuten: 'Gaat niet goed met ons'
items.summary: Michael Carrick is vrijdagmiddag uitgebreid ingegaan op de situatie bij Manchester United. De manager van de club begon een persconferentie met een speech die zo'n zes minuten duurde. Het gaat niet goed met de club, erkent ook Carrick, die nog wel gebrand is om het tij te keren.

items.title: Crystal Palace and Newcastle face off with both in search of season kickstart
items.summary: Pierre Sage and Matthias Jaissle were appointed this summer and good form has been elusive, with injuries and tactics as factors Conceding 17 goals in seven Premier League matches is not exactly the start Pierre Sage or Crystal Palace’s hierarchy would have hoped for. The transition from Oliver Glasner’s counterattacking 3-4-2-1 formation to the Frenchman’s more aggressive approach has exposed massive weaknesses in defence, culminating with last week’s humiliating defeat at Brighton. Palace fans became used to success under Glasner and they are already looking nervously over their shoulders at the bottom three. Even their league wins under Sage so far – against Fulham and Nottingham Forest – could have ended in defeat. Something doesn’t seem right in south London. EA Continue reading...

items.title: Van Bronckhorst wijst PSV als favoriet aan voor duel met koploper Feyenoord
items.summary: Zondag staat de topper tussen Feyenoord en PSV op het programma. De Rotterdammers voeren de ranglijst van de Eredivisie dan wel aan, maar zijn volgens Giovanni van Bronckhorst niet de favoriet.

items.title: Conte plays down 'unfounded' Man Utd speculation
items.summary: Antonio Conte says he is not in advanced talks with any club, in response to speculation he has held talks with Manchester United.

items.title: Slegers and misfiring Arsenal badly need a result in WSL north London derby
items.summary: Gunners’ title hopes have seemingly evaporated and their under-pressure head coach faces her latest test against Spurs on Saturday It says much about Arsenal’s predicament that the team who have conceded 12 goals in two games are not the side whose head coach is under most pressure before a north London derby. Tottenham, four points above their neighbours before Saturday’s meeting, may have been humbled in consecutive Women’s Super League matches but all eyes are on Renée Slegers. Arsenal are winless in five WSL matches for the first time, and the most decorated club in English women’s football desperately need a turning point. Their failure to beat Birmingham at home last Saturday, dropping points against a promoted side for the second time this season, again demonstrated the team’s inability to convert possession into goals. They increasingly look like a team stuck in Groundhog Day. Continue reading...

items.title: Is el clásico still the world’s biggest match? Three questions before Barcelona v Real Madrid
items.summary: The fixture’s relevance waned as the Messi-Ronaldo rivalry faded. Can Lamine Yamal and Mbappé lift it into a new era? For the best part of a decade, el clásico was more than just soccer’s biggest fixture. It was the defining narrative. At the peak of the Lionel Messi v Cristiano Ronaldo era, there were clásicos everywhere. Yes, when the two historic rivals clashed on the pitch, but also in the voting for the Ballon d’Or every year and in so much of the discourse around the sport. As the Messi-Ronaldo rivalry faded, though, so too did the clásico’s relevance. This isn’t to say matches between Barcelona and Real Madrid no longer matter. They always have and always will. In 2026, however, it’s difficult to measure a clásico’s standing. Is it still the sport’s biggest fixture? Continue reading...

items.title: Chaotic state of football in Brazil epitomises a nation where greed has conquered glory | Jonathan Liew
items.summary: The national game merely reflects the mood in a divided nation which is going to the polls with very little faith in the power of democracy Look, cards on the table: I don’t know for certain, and nor do you, whether Flávio Bolsonaro – the man widely tipped to become the next president of Brazil after Sunday night’s election – really did steal an island from Richarlison. There are lawyers involved, claims and counter-claims, and in any case, adjudicating land ownership disputes between right-wing strongmen and Tottenham reserve-team strikers lies very much beyond this column’s spectrum of expertise. It’s why, for example, this newspaper took no official position on the well-publicised battle between Rodrigo Duterte and Vincent Janssen over that Polynesian isthmus. According to Richarlison, a few years ago he purchased an island off the southern coast of Rio de Janeiro, and has the documentation to prove it. Richarlison says Bolsonaro tried to buy it from him, and when he refused a lawyer named Willer Tomaz simply turned up and annexed it. “These guys took the island without spending a penny, as far as I know,” Richarlison claimed in an Instagram video that has been viewed more than 31 million times. Tomaz has accused Richarlison of lying, arguing that he has a public deed registered at the notary’s office. Bolsonaro, for his part, has denied any connection with the island in question and described Richarlison’s intervention as “politically motivated”. Continue reading...

items.title: Matthieu Epolo défend Vincent Euvrard au Standard et affirme : "Je ne suis plus le même qu'il y a 2-3 ans"
items.summary: Leader technique grâce à ses nombreux arrêts, Matthieu Epolo devient également de plus en plus un leader mental au Standard, lui qui disputera son 75e match avec l'équipe première des Rouches dimanche à Genk. Le portier de 21 ans grandit de semaine en semaine et commence aussi à acquérir une expérience internationale qui pourrait lui servir dans son quotidien en bord de Meuse.

items.title: Manchester United in crisis: Rooney wil dat Carrick komaf maakt met “meneer de brave”
items.summary: Michael Carrick staat voor een bijzonder moeilijke keuze bij Manchester United. Moet hij Bruno Fernandes, zijn aanvoerder en volgens velen zijn beste speler, aan de kant schuiven na diens openlijke kritiek op de tactiek? In aanloop naar het duel met Bournemouth lopen de meningen uiteen. Volgens clublegende Wayne Rooney dreigt de situatie zelfs de kleedkamer uit elkaar te trekken.

items.title: Belgische clubs verdienen 3,4 miljoen euro met Europese zeges: Club Brugge krijgt het meest
items.summary: De Belgische clubs hebben niet alleen goede zaken gedaan voor de Europese coëfficiënt. Hun overwinningen leveren ook een mooi bedrag op via de wedstrijdpremies van de UEFA. Club Brugge, Anderlecht, Union en STVV wonnen allemaal hun Europese wedstrijd en verdienen daar samen 3,4 miljoen euro mee.

items.title: Un timing mal réfléchi : le choc entre le PSG et Lyon reporté... en pleine cérémonie du Ballon d'Or
items.summary: Le Paris Saint-Germain compte en ses rangs l'un ou l'autre favori au Ballon d'Or, qui sera décerné ce lundi à Zurich. Mais la LFP n'en a cure : la rencontre entre le PSG et l'OL, prévue ce dimanche, va être reportée en pleine cérémonie de remise du trophée.

items.title: Vitor Bruno se rapproche enfin d'un onze-type : voici ce qui se dessine
items.summary: Après des semaines d'expérimentation et de tournante parfois forcée par les circonstances et un calendrier surchargé, Vitor Bruno tient peut-être enfin ce qui ressemble à une équipe-type. Le match réalisé hier en Pologne donne en tout cas de belles indications.

items.title: Ex-international haalt keihard uit naar Ballon d'Or: “Grootste clownswedstrijd ter wereld”
items.summary: Maandagavond verzamelen de grootste sterren uit het voetbal voor de uitreiking van de Ballon d'Or. Maar niet iedereen kijkt reikhalzend uit naar het prestigieuze gala. Markus Babbel, voormalig international van Duitsland, heeft bijzonder weinig respect voor de verkiezing en vindt dat de individuele prijs zelfs helemaal moet verdwijnen.

items.title: Anderlecht-speler maakt indruk met enorme werkkracht: “Ik denk dat ik de snelste ben”
items.summary: Bij Anderlecht zijn de wissels in de basiself van Vitor Bruno schering en inslag, maar één speler blijft opvallend vaak staan. De Duitser Marten Winkler is uitgegroeid tot een vaste waarde en stond in de laatste zeven wedstrijden telkens aan de aftrap. Alleen Léo Pétrot kan dezelfde reeks voorleggen. Dat schrijft La Dernière Heure.

items.title: Napoli-coach Allegri geeft De Bruyne de sleutels in topmatch en legt uit waarom
items.summary: Kevin De Bruyne lijkt opnieuw een belangrijke rol te krijgen bij Napoli. Na de recente zege tegen Bodo/Glimt wil Napoli bevestigen dat het de juiste weg is ingeslagen.
